name: 陳儀
objective: This course is specifically designed for overseas Chinese and Hong Kong-Macau students. Through the study of literary works, discussions on contemporary textual issues, and creative literary writing, it aims to develop students' Chinese comprehension, communication, and appreciation skills while deepening their understanding of culture, the world, and their own lives. Additionally, the course incorporates practical applications to enhance students' proficiency in using Chinese in professional settings.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1  Course Introduction
Week 2  Lesson 1, 17 or 25-Years Old?
Week 3  The Social dilemma
Week 4  Teachers’ Day
Week 5  Lesson 2, A Feast for the Eyes and Ears
Week 6  Field Trip: National Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
Week 7  Lesson 3, Cloud Technology
Week 8  Retrocession Day Make-up Holiday
Week 9  What's Next? AI 2027
Week 10  School Anniversary Make-up Holiday
Week 11  Lesson 4, Where Should the Bed Go?
Week 12  Research with AI Tools
Week 13  Lesson 5, Pursuing Your Dreams
Week 14  About My Dream Life 
Week 15  Final Exam
Week 16  Video Project
Week 17  Flexible Learning Week
Week 18  Flexible Learning Week

remarks:
1. The course focuses on Chinese language and culture throughout the semester, aligning with SDG 4, “Quality Education.” 

2. From Weeks 2 to 16, students are required to observe their surroundings and reflect on their own lives in connection with the course materials. This component of the course corresponds to the third dimension of Innovative Character Education, “Exhortation” (Exhortation), which encourages self-reflection, personal growth, and positive development.
